sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Public Service Commission Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission
Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th September, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(20)/73/6744, dated
16-9-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Public Service Commission (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 9th day of August, 2002.

Amendment of section 4 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XI of 1978

ORDINANCE XXXII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Public Service Commission
Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th September, 2002]
No. LEGIS:1(20)/73/6744, dated
16-9-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 4 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XI of 1978.---In the North-West Frontier Province
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XI of 1978),
in section 4, in subsection (l ), for the existing proviso, the following shall
be substituted, namely:
"Provided that,
notwithstanding his taking oath, required by the provisions of section 4A, on a
date subsequent upon his entering into office, the Chairman or a member shall
hold office for his respective term from the date on which he entered upon
office and not from the date of oath taking, and he shall not be eligible for
reappointment."
